engineer_time.missing: Not tracked; scripts do not measure engineer productivity

budget.boundary: Diagnostic phase only; executed prefixes reserve additional slots. Slots include attempts interrupted before completion. Confirmation is a separately equal obligation.

diagnosis_record.interpretation: A diagnostic proposal is not a confirmed correction; no acceptance is claimed before fresh final confirmation
